meta.title: Telangana welfare schemes: grounded source pack for the Gnani helpline
meta.language_note: Facts and bases are in English; question_te, fail_message_te, notice_te and summary_te are Telugu for direct use in speech.

confidence_levels.high: Stated by an official government page/portal or by an official order/statement reported consistently by reputable outlets.
confidence_levels.medium: Reported by one reputable outlet or by explainers that agree with each other. State with care and keep the caveat.
confidence_levels.low: Single or conflicting secondary report. Never state as fact; use only to say the sources disagree.

source_tiers.official: Official Telangana/Central government page or portal
source_tiers.public_broadcaster: All India Radio (public broadcaster) news report
source_tiers.major_news: Established news outlet (reporting a GO, official statement or event)
source_tiers.secondary: Aggregator/explainer; use only for low-stakes details and never alone

assistant_rules: Only state claims that appear in a scheme's facts or criteria, and cite their source_ids.

status values other than 'active' (disputed, not_confirmed_launched, completed_one_time, active_amount_hike_not_implemented, active_implementation_unclear) must be mentioned before benefits are described.
For anything listed in unknown_in_sources, say once that published sources do not cover it and point to the official office or portal. Do not guess.
Facts with confidence 'low' must not be stated as fact.
Eligibility results use wording like 'appears to meet the published criteria'; final decisions rest with officials.
limitations: Most sources here are established news outlets reporting government orders; official portals were reachable only for some schemes. Re-check the official page before launch for anything marked medium or low.
Rythu Bharosa and Indiramma Indlu content is carried over from the user's own verification files (22 Oct 2026) and was not re-fetched.
Government schemes change often; this pack reflects what could be found on 28 Oct 2026.

schemes.name_en: Mahalakshmi: Free bus travel for women (TGSRTC)
schemes.status_note: Running since 9 Dec 2023. Smart-card rollout was announced for 2 June 2026; Aadhaar/ID still accepted per the pre-launch report.
schemes.summary_en: Women, girls and transgender persons residing in Telangana travel free (zero ticket) in covered TGSRTC buses within the state. No application is needed for the travel itself.
schemes.summary_te: తెలంగాణలో నివసించే మహిళలు, బాలికలు, ట్రాన్స్‌జెండర్ వ్యక్తులు TGSRTC లోని కొన్ని రకాల బస్సుల్లో రాష్ట్రం లోపల ఉచితంగా ప్రయాణించవచ్చు. ఇందుకోసం ప్రత్యేకంగా దరఖాస్తు చేయాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు.

facts.claim: The free travel scheme started on 9 December 2023.
Women, girls and transgender persons who are residents (domiciles) of Telangana are covered.
The initial government order made travel free in Palle Velugu and Express buses up to the borders of Telangana.
TGSRTC said in March 2026 the scheme operates in about 81% of its buses: Pallevelugu, District Express, City Ordinary and City Metro Express.
Deluxe and super luxury buses (and AC buses) are reported as not covered.
facts.note: Exact list of excluded services not seen in an official order; confirm with TGSRTC.

facts.claim: Passengers get a zero-fare ticket by showing an Aadhaar card (or other government ID) to the conductor.

A chip-based Mahalakshmi Smart Card (Rs 50 fee, apply at MeeSeva centres or TGSRTC bus pass counters with Aadhaar, passport photo and mobile number) was announced for launch on 2 June 2026; officials said it may become mandatory later.
facts.note: This is a pre-launch report; the actual rollout status was not confirmed.

facts.claim: Over 200 crore zero tickets were issued by July 2025; TGSRTC reported more than 290 crore free journeys by March 2026.

criteria.question_te: మీరు మహిళ, బాలిక లేదా ట్రాన్స్‌జెండర్ వ్యక్తియా?
criteria.basis: Free travel for women, girls and transgender persons.
criteria.fail_message_te: ఈ పథకం మహిళలు, బాలికలు మరియు ట్రాన్స్‌జెండర్ వ్యక్తుల కోసం మాత్రమే.

criteria.question_te: మీరు తెలంగాణలో నివసిస్తున్నారా?
criteria.basis: Scheme is for residents (domiciles) of Telangana.
criteria.fail_message_te: ఈ ఉచిత ప్రయాణం తెలంగాణలో నివసించే వారికి మాత్రమే ఉద్దేశించినది.

criteria.question_te: మీరు ఎక్కే బస్సు పల్లె వెలుగు, ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్, సిటీ ఆర్డినరీ లేదా సిటీ మెట్రో ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్ రకమా?
criteria.basis: TGSRTC lists Pallevelugu, District Express, City Ordinary and City Metro Express as covered.
criteria.fail_message_te: డీలక్స్, సూపర్ లగ్జరీ, ఏసీ వంటి ఇతర రకాల బస్సుల్లో ఈ ఉచిత ప్రయాణం వర్తించదని నివేదికలు చెబుతున్నాయి.

criteria.question_te: మీ ప్రయాణం తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర సరిహద్దుల లోపలేనా?
criteria.basis: Free travel is up to the borders of Telangana.
criteria.fail_message_te: ఉచిత ప్రయాణం తెలంగాణ సరిహద్దుల వరకు మాత్రమే.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Whether the Mahalakshmi Smart Card has become mandatory and how far the rollout has progressed
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: స్మార్ట్ కార్డు తప్పనిసరి అయిందా, ఎంతవరకు అమలైందో ఖచ్చితంగా తెలియదు — బస్సు కండక్టర్ లేదా TGSRTC వద్ద నిర్ధారించుకోండి.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Official complete list of services where the scheme does not apply
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: ఏఏ బస్సు సర్వీసుల్లో వర్తించదనే పూర్తి అధికారిక జాబితా నా వద్ద లేదు — TGSRTC వద్ద చూడండి.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Rules for women who live outside Telangana or hold a non-Telangana Aadhaar
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: తెలంగాణ బయట నివసించే మహిళలకు నియమాలు మూలాల్లో స్పష్టంగా లేవు.

schemes.how_to_apply: No application for the travel. Show Aadhaar or other government ID to the conductor and collect the zero ticket. Smart card: MeeSeva centre or TGSRTC bus pass counter.
schemes.portal: https://tgsrtc.telangana.gov.in (as named by TGSRTC; not fetched in this pass)

schemes.name_en: Mahalakshmi: Rs 2,500 per month for women (promised, not confirmed as launched)
schemes.name_te: మహాలక్ష్మి: మహిళలకు నెలకు రూ. 2,500 (హామీ; అమలు నిర్ధారణ కాలేదు)
schemes.status_note: Promised in the Congress Six Guarantees. Reputable reports through 2025 describe it as pending. A viral video claiming a Bathukamma rollout was confirmed a deepfake in October 2026. Several aggregator sites claim a 2026 launch, but no reputable report was found. The assistant must NOT tell users it is being paid.
schemes.summary_en: The Rs 2,500/month assistance is part of the promised Mahalakshmi guarantee. No reputable source found confirms that it has been launched, and its eligibility rules have not been published in any source found.
schemes.summary_te: నెలకు రూ. 2,500 సాయం మహాలక్ష్మి హామీలో భాగం. అయితే ఇది అమలులోకి వచ్చినట్లు నమ్మదగిన మూలాల్లో నిర్ధారణ కాలేదు, అర్హతా నిబంధనలు కూడా ప్రకటించినట్లు కనిపించలేదు.

facts.claim: Rs 2,500 per month for women is one of the Congress Six Guarantees; Mahalakshmi has three components (free bus travel, Rs 500 gas cylinder, Rs 2,500 monthly aid).
In July 2025 the monthly allowance was reported as long pending since the Congress took office, with the government citing financial challenges.
A fact-check found that the Rs 2,500 aid had not materialised despite Congress leaders' claims.
facts.note: Dated early 2025; later developments should be checked.

facts.claim: On 8 October 2026 a viral video of the Chief Minister promising Rs 2,500 monthly aid from Bathukamma and two tolas of gold under Kalyana Lakshmi was reported as officially confirmed to be a deepfake.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Whether the Rs 2,500 monthly assistance has been launched and paid anywhere
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: రూ. 2,500 నెలవారీ సాయం అమలులోకి వచ్చినట్లు నిర్ధారణ లేదు — అధికారిక ప్రకటన కోసం చూడండి.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Eligibility rules, income limits, application process
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: అర్హతలు, ఆదాయ పరిమితి, దరఖాస్తు విధానం ఇంకా ప్రకటించినట్లు మూలాల్లో లేవు.

schemes.how_to_apply: No application process found. Beware of fake messages and videos.

schemes.status_note: Launched 27 Feb 2024 by government order for white ration card holders with active domestic LPG connections.
schemes.summary_en: Eligible white ration card families with an active domestic LPG connection get a domestic LPG refill at a subsidised Rs 500.
schemes.summary_te: తెల్ల రేషన్ కార్డు ఉండి, క్రియాశీల గృహ గ్యాస్ కనెక్షన్ ఉన్న కుటుంబాలకు గృహ వినియోగ గ్యాస్ సిలిండర్ రూ. 500కే లభిస్తుంది.

facts.claim: Launched on 27 February 2024 together with Gruha Jyothi.
The government order sanctions a domestic LPG refill at Rs 500 for white ration card (food security card) holders.
Beneficiaries must have an active domestic LPG connection.

At launch only those who had applied during Praja Palana were eligible; the Civil Supplies Minister said those who had not applied could still enrol if they hold a white ration card and an LPG connection.
The minister said about 40 lakh families were expected to benefit.

criteria.question_te: మీ కుటుంబానికి తెల్ల రేషన్ కార్డు (ఆహార భద్రతా కార్డు) ఉందా?
criteria.basis: GO sanctions Rs 500 LPG refill to white ration card (food security card) holders.
criteria.fail_message_te: ఈ పథకం తెల్ల రేషన్ కార్డు ఉన్న కుటుంబాలకు మాత్రమే.

criteria.question_te: మీకు ప్రస్తుతం క్రియాశీలంగా ఉన్న గృహ వినియోగ గ్యాస్ కనెక్షన్ ఉందా?
criteria.basis: Eligible households must have an active domestic LPG connection.
criteria.fail_message_te: ఈ పథకానికి క్రియాశీల గృహ గ్యాస్ కనెక్షన్ ఉండాలి.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Whether the LPG connection must be in a woman's name (one report says yes; others say in the applicant's name)
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: గ్యాస్ కనెక్షన్ మహిళ పేరు మీద ఉండాలా అనే విషయంలో మూలాలు ఒకేలా చెప్పడం లేదు — ధృవీకరించుకోండి.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Annual cap on subsidised cylinders
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: సంవత్సరానికి ఎన్ని సిలిండర్లకు వర్తిస్తుందో మూలాల్లో స్పష్టంగా లేదు.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Whether the user pays Rs 500 at delivery or pays full price and gets the difference by transfer
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: రూ. 500 చెల్లించే విధానం (డెలివరీ సమయంలోనా, తర్వాత ఖాతాలో జమనా) మూలాల్లో స్పష్టంగా లేదు.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Whether new enrolments are open now
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: ఇప్పుడు కొత్తగా నమోదు చేసుకునే అవకాశం ఉందో లేదో మూలాల్లో లేదు — గ్యాస్ ఏజెన్సీ/పౌర సరఫరాల శాఖ వద్ద చూడండి.

schemes.how_to_apply: Originally via Praja Palana forms; the minister later said eligible families who had not applied could still enrol. Current procedure not confirmed.

schemes.name_en: Gruha Jyothi: 200 units of free electricity
schemes.status_note: Government order dated 26 Feb 2024; launched 27 Feb 2024; zero bills started 1 Mar 2024.
schemes.summary_en: Eligible households with a white ration card get a zero electricity bill for domestic consumption up to 200 units per month on a single service connection.
schemes.summary_te: తెల్ల రేషన్ కార్డు ఉన్న అర్హ కుటుంబాలకు ఒకే గృహ విద్యుత్ కనెక్షన్‌పై నెలకు 200 యూనిట్ల వరకు వినియోగానికి జీరో బిల్లు వస్తుంది.

facts.claim: The government order is dated 26 February 2024; the scheme was launched on 27 February 2024 and zero bills began on 1 March 2024.
Eligible households get a zero bill for domestic consumption up to 200 units a month.
Households need a white ration card linked with Aadhaar and a single domestic service connection linked to the ration card (USC number from the electricity bill).
A household that uses more than 200 units in a month does not get the zero bill for that month, according to reports on the government order.
facts.note: Applies month by month; confirm with the discom.

facts.claim: Consumers who believe they qualify but were billed can approach the MPDO office, Municipal Commissioner or the relevant electricity circle office.
The free power applies to domestic use only.

criteria.question_te: మీ కుటుంబానికి తెల్ల రేషన్ కార్డు (ఆహార భద్రతా కార్డు) ఉందా?
criteria.basis: Eligible beneficiaries must hold a valid white ration card.
criteria.fail_message_te: ఈ పథకం తెల్ల రేషన్ కార్డు ఉన్న కుటుంబాలకు మాత్రమే.

criteria.question_te: మీ రేషన్ కార్డు ఆధార్‌తో అనుసంధానమై ఉందా?
criteria.basis: White ration card must be linked with Aadhaar.
criteria.fail_message_te: రేషన్ కార్డు ఆధార్‌తో అనుసంధానం కావాలి.

criteria.question_te: మీ గృహ విద్యుత్ కనెక్షన్ (ఒకే సర్వీస్ కనెక్షన్) మీ రేషన్ కార్డుతో అనుసంధానమై ఉందా?
criteria.basis: Single domestic service connection linked to the ration card.
criteria.fail_message_te: గృహ వినియోగ కనెక్షన్ ఒక్కటే, అది రేషన్ కార్డుతో అనుసంధానమై ఉండాలి.

criteria.question_te: మీ నెలవారీ గృహ విద్యుత్ వినియోగం 200 యూనిట్లలోపేనా?
criteria.basis: Zero bill for consumption up to 200 units per month.
criteria.fail_message_te: 200 యూనిట్లు దాటిన నెలలో జీరో బిల్లు వర్తించదని నివేదికలు చెబుతున్నాయి.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Whether any income ceiling applies beyond holding a white ration card
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: తెల్ల రేషన్ కార్డు తప్ప ఆదాయ పరిమితి ఉందా అనేది ప్రచురించిన మూలాల్లో లేదు.

unknown_in_sources.topic: Rules for tenants whose connection is in the landlord's name
unknown_in_sources.notice_te: అద్దె ఇంట్లో ఉండి కనెక్షన్ యజమాని పేరు మీద ఉన్నవారికి నియమాలు మూలాల్లో లేవు.

schemes.how_to_apply: Originally through Praja Palana. Unlinked eligible consumers can approach MPDO / Municipal Commissioner / electricity circle office with the white ration card and electricity bill.

schemes.name_en: Rajiv Aarogyasri: health cover up to Rs 10 lakh per family per year
schemes.name_te: రాజీవ్ ఆరోగ్యశ్రీ: కుటుంబానికి సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 10 లక్షల వరకు వైద్య సాయం
schemes.status_note: Cover doubled from Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh from December 2023. Hospital payment disputes were reported in September 2025; confirm current service at the hospital.
schemes.summary_en: Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals for BPL families identified through the food security (white ration) card, up to Rs 10 lakh per family per year. The limit is for approved packages, not every expense.
schemes.summary_te: ఆహార భద్రతా (తెల్ల రేషన్) కార్డు ఉన్న పేద కుటుంబాలకు ఎంపానెల్డ్ ఆసుపత్రుల్లో సంవత్సరానికి కుటుంబానికి రూ. 10 లక్షల వరకు నగదు రహిత చికిత్స. ఇది ఆమోదిత ప్యాకేజీలకే వర్తిస్తుంది, ప్రతి ఖర్చుకు కాదు.

facts.claim: The Rs 10 lakh cover was launched on 9 December 2023 under the Rajiv Aarogyasri / Cheyutha banner; the ceiling earlier was Rs 5 lakh.
Cashless treatment up to Rs 10 lakh per family per year for BPL households.
The Aarogyasri Trust described the scheme as covering over 99 lakh BPL families; the 2025-26 budget coverage said 90.10 lakh BPL families.
Beneficiaries are identified through the Food Security Card (white ration card) and the Civil Supplies database.
Coverage is package-based and depends on hospital empanelment and authorisation; Rs 10 lakh is a limit, not a guarantee that every expense is paid.
In 2025 health cards were extended to orphans for treatment up to Rs 10 lakh; in emergencies an income certificate signed by the Tahsildar can serve as an alternative to a ration card.
In September 2025 private hospitals threatened to suspend Aarogyasri services over pending dues.
facts.note: Dated; services may have resumed. Do not state current availability.

criteria.question_te: మీరు తెలంగాణలో నివసిస్తున్నారా?
criteria.basis: Scheme is for BPL families of Telangana.
criteria.fail_message_te: ఈ పథకం తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర కుటుంబాల కోసం.

criteria.question_te: మీ కుటుంబానికి తెల్ల రేషన్ కార్డు (ఆహార భద్రతా కార్డు) ఉందా?

facts.claim: Housing initiative giving financial assistance to eligible landless and homeless families in Telangana to construct permanent houses on their own plots.
Assistance is Rs 5 lakh per eligible family.
The Wanaparthy page uses the wording '100% subsidy'; the state portal does not state this percentage, so treat it as the district page's description and not a universal cost guarantee.
Landless beneficiaries MAY receive a 250 sq yd residential plot; this is conditional, not an unconditional entitlement. The state portal states no plot size.

Mulugu district page (7 Aug 2025): L1 = owns a small piece of land but no permanent house; L2 = highly prioritised homeless families owning neither land nor house, may receive a free 250 sq yd plot; L3 = already owns a permanent house, ineligible for new sanction.
Officials monitor construction through a mobile app with geocoordinates and stage-wise progress.
Application/information portal: https://indirammaindlu.telangana.gov.in/
The 20 Dec 2023 date on the Wanaparthy page is page metadata, not the scheme launch date.

schemes.summary_en: Income support of Rs 6,000 per acre per crop season (Rs 12,000 per acre a year for Rabi and Kharif) by DBT to small/marginal farmers, tenant farmers and agricultural labourers on agriculturally suitable land.
schemes.summary_te: చిన్న/స్వల్ప రైతులు, కౌలు రైతులు, వ్యవసాయ కూలీలకు వ్యవసాయ యోగ్యమైన భూమికి ఎకరాకు ప్రతి పంట కాలానికి రూ. 6,000 (రబీ, ఖరీఫ్ కలిపి ఏడాదికి రూ. 12,000) నేరుగా బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో జమ.

facts.claim: Rs 6,000 per acre per crop season; Rs 12,000 per acre annually for Rabi and Kharif.
facts.note: No GO page cited: the GO PDF was a scanned image.

facts.claim: Payment is by DBT into registered bank accounts, in phases during crop seasons.
Tenant farmers and agricultural labourers are covered, along with small/marginal farmers.
Mining, industrial and real-estate land is excluded; only agriculturally suitable land qualifies.
Aadhaar, land/lease proof, bank passbook, ration card, domicile proof, mobile number and PAN are listed as required documents.
The sentence 'all farmers residing in Telangana and owning lands are eligible' is contradicted by the detailed eligibility section and must not be used.
Official portal: https://rythubharosa.telangana.gov.in/

schemes.summary_en: Free life insurance of Rs 5 lakh for pattadar farmers aged 18 to 59, paid to the nominee on the farmer's death from any cause; the government pays the premium to LIC. Reports in Sep-Oct 2026 say renewal premium payment is in doubt.

facts.claim: Rs 5 lakh insurance cover to the farmer's nominee on death due to any cause, including natural death.
The entire premium is paid by the government to LIC; the farmer pays nothing.
Farmers aged 18 to 59 are eligible; a court judgment extract says age is counted as on 15 August of the enrolment year.
Enrolled farmers are pattadars (land-owning farmers).

Telangana Today reported on 4 Sep 2026 that the state had failed to pay the premium, halting the programme, and on 4 Oct 2026 that the last date to pay LIC was 14 August with premium unpaid and claims pending or returned.
facts.note: Single outlet; government response not found. Re-check before stating status.

schemes.name_en: Rythu Runa Mafi (crop loan waiver up to Rs 2 lakh)
schemes.status_note: One-time waiver implemented in phases in July-August 2024. No open application window was found. Disputes about farmers left out continue.
schemes.summary_en: Short-term crop loans taken between 12 Dec 2018 and 9 Dec 2023 were waived up to Rs 2 lakh per family (principal plus interest), with a ration card required for the family. The government says 22.37 lakh farmers got Rs 17,934 crore; the opposition says many were excluded.
schemes.summary_te: 2018 డిసెంబర్ 12 నుంచి 2023 డిసెంబర్ 9 మధ్య తీసుకున్న స్వల్పకాలిక పంట రుణాలు కుటుంబానికి రూ. 2 లక్షల వరకు మాఫీ చేశారు. ఇది ఒకసారి అమలైన పథకం.

facts.claim: Cabinet approved waiving crop loans up to Rs 2 lakh per farmer for loans taken between 12 December 2018 and 9 December 2023.

Guidelines (July 2024): ceiling Rs 2 lakh per family including principal and interest; short-term loans from scheduled commercial banks, RRBs and DCCBs; waived bottom-up; ration card mandatory; not applicable to SHG, JLG, Rythu Mitra Groups, LECs or rescheduled loans.
The remaining waiver up to Rs 2 lakh was released on 15 August 2024 as the third phase.
The government claimed it waived Rs 2 lakh crop loans of 22.37 lakh farmers at a cost of Rs 17,934 crore; the BRS said lakhs were left out.
facts.note: Government claim vs opposition claim; present as claims.

criteria.question_te: మీరు 2018 డిసెంబర్ 12 నుంచి 2023 డిసెంబర్ 9 మధ్య పంట రుణం తీసుకున్నారా?

schemes.status_note: The promised Rs 4,000 old-age pension had not been implemented as of 1 Oct 2026 per Telangana Today (via a secondary summary). Current rates: Rs 2,016 for most categories, Rs 4,016 for disability. Sources disagree on some details; see facts.
schemes.summary_en: Monthly pension of Rs 2,016 for old age (57+), widows and other listed categories, and Rs 4,016 for persons with disabilities. The Rs 4,000 promise is not yet implemented.
schemes.summary_te: వృద్ధాప్య (57 ఏళ్లు పైబడినవారు), వితంతు మరియు ఇతర వర్గాలకు నెలకు రూ. 2,016, దివ్యాంగులకు రూ. 4,016. రూ. 4,000 హామీ ఇంకా అమలు కాలేదు.

facts.claim: Published monthly rates: old age Rs 2,016, widow Rs 2,016, disability Rs 4,016.
The proposed increase of the old-age pension from Rs 2,016 to Rs 4,000 was reported as not implemented as of 1 October 2026.
facts.note: Secondary summary of a Telangana Today report; verify before stating as final.

facts.claim: A Rs 4,000 monthly pension is among the promises criticised as unfulfilled by the opposition.
Old-age pension eligibility starts at 57 years in several explainers (earlier 65).
facts.note: Confirm with the local MPDO/municipal office.

facts.claim: Persons with disabilities: no minimum age, SADAREM-certified disability of 40% or more (51% for hearing impairment) per one explainer.
Categories reported: old age, widows, single women, weavers, toddy tappers, beedi workers, HIV/AIDS and filaria patients, persons with disabilities.
Some older/low-quality reports claim the Rs 4,000 and Rs 6,000 amounts were already paid; this conflicts with the 1 Oct 2026 report and is not used.

schemes.how_to_apply: Offline via Gram Panchayat / municipal office per explainers; status via the Cheyutha (SSPTG) portal. Not confirmed from an official page in this pass.

schemes.status_note: Running since 2 Oct 2014. The promised gold (tula) addition was not found in any reputable report; a viral video claiming it was confirmed a deepfake in Oct 2026.
schemes.summary_en: One-time marriage assistance of Rs 1,00,116 for brides aged 18 or more from eligible families (Kalyana Lakshmi for SC/ST/BC/EBC, Shaadi Mubarak for minorities), with parents' combined annual income up to Rs 2 lakh.
schemes.summary_te: 18 ఏళ్లు నిండిన అర్హ వధువులకు వివాహ సమయంలో ఒకసారి రూ. 1,00,116 సహాయం (SC/ST/BC/EBC లకు కళ్యాణలక్ష్మి, మైనారిటీలకు షాదీ ముబారక్). తల్లిదండ్రుల మొత్తం వార్షిక ఆదాయం రూ. 2 లక్షల లోపు ఉండాలి.

facts.claim: Launched on 2 October 2014 to support marriage expenses and discourage child marriage; assistance is conditional on the bride being at least 18.
Assistance is Rs 1,00,116 per bride.
facts.note: Amount repeated by many explainers; confirm on ePASS.

facts.claim: Parents of disabled girls get Rs 1,25,145 under the Shaadi Mubarak listing on the national MyScheme portal.
The combined annual income of the bride's parents should be less than Rs 2 lakh.
It is one-time assistance, available only once in a lifetime.
The scheme is for unmarried girls aged 18 or more.
Applicants apply online through the Telangana ePASS website under Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak.
16.78 lakh beneficiaries by October 2026.
No reputable report found that gold has been added to the assistance; a viral video claiming this was reported as a deepfake on 8 Oct 2026.

schemes.name_en: Rajiv Yuva Vikasam (self-employment subsidy for youth)
schemes.status_note: Launched 17 Mar 2025. About 16.25 lakh applications received; sources conflict on subsidy slabs and age limits, and implementation progress is unclear.
schemes.summary_en: Bank-linked subsidy for unemployed youth from SC, ST, BC, EBC and minority communities to start self-employment units, reported as up to Rs 3-4 lakh. Slabs reported differ between sources.
schemes.summary_te: SC, ST, BC, EBC, మైనారిటీ వర్గాల నిరుద్యోగ యువతకు స్వయం ఉపాధి యూనిట్లు ప్రారంభించడానికి బ్యాంకు రుణంతో కలిపి సబ్సిడీ (రూ. 3–4 లక్షల వరకు అని నివేదికలు). సబ్సిడీ శ్లాబులపై మూలాలు ఒకేలా లేవు.

facts.claim: The Chief Minister launched Rajiv Yuva Vikasam on 17 March 2025.
Young people can receive concessional loans of up to Rs 4 lakh along with subsidies to set up businesses or self-employment units.
Income limit reported as Rs 1.5 lakh per year in rural areas and Rs 2 lakh in urban areas.
Age limit reported as 21 to 60 for rural and 21 to 55 for urban applicants by one outlet; another explainer says 21-55 (21-60 for agriculture units).
facts.note: Conflicting; do not state a single age band as certain.

facts.claim: Subsidy slab reports differ: one lists 100% up to Rs 50,000, 90% up to Rs 1 lakh, 80% up to Rs 2 lakh, 70% up to Rs 4 lakh; another says 80% to Rs 1 lakh, 70% to Rs 2 lakh and 60% to Rs 3 lakh; another says 60% for Rs 3-4 lakh.
facts.note: Do not quote a slab to users until verified on the official portal.

facts.claim: About 16.25 lakh people applied and a large share were expected to be rejected.
Reports say a CIBIL score requirement applies for the bank-linked part.

schemes.name_en: New ration cards and free fine rice (6 kg per person)
schemes.name_te: కొత్త రేషన్ కార్డులు మరియు ఉచిత సన్న బియ్యం (ఒక్కొక్కరికి 6 కిలోలు)
schemes.status_note: A white ration card (food security card) is the gateway to several other schemes (Gruha Jyothi, LPG Rs 500, Aarogyasri, loan waiver).
schemes.summary_en: Eligible families hold food security cards and receive 6 kg of fine rice per person per month free. New card issuance began in 2025 after a long gap.
schemes.summary_te: ఆహార భద్రతా కార్డు ఉన్న అర్హ కుటుంబాలకు ఒక్కొక్కరికి నెలకు 6 కిలోల సన్న బియ్యం ఉచితంగా లభిస్తుంది. 2025లో చాలా ఏళ్ల తర్వాత కొత్త కార్డుల జారీ మొదలైంది.

facts.claim: 6 kg of fine rice per person per month is given free through fair price shops to about 3.1 crore people (about 84% of the population) at a cost of over Rs 13,000 crore a year (Civil Supplies Minister, July 2025).
New ration card issuance and name additions began from 26 January 2025; mass distribution of new cards was launched in mid-July 2025 (reports give 13 or 14 July).
About 17 lakh new names were added to existing cards between February and May 2025, and applications were taken through MeeSeva centres.
As of August 2026 the Civil Supplies Minister said there were 1,06,28,092 food security cards covering 3.43 crore beneficiaries, with 16,32,810 new cards issued since 26 Jan 2025.
A move to smart ration cards was announced in August 2026.
The minister in charge said no new criteria were laid down for new cards and past eligibility rules would be followed.

criteria.question_te: మీరు తెలంగాణలో నివసిస్తున్నారా?

unknown_in_sources.notice_te: ఇప్పుడు కొత్త కార్డుకు ఎలా దరఖాస్తు చేయాలి, ఏ పత్రాలు కావాలనేది మూలాల్లో నిర్ధారణ కాలేదు.
